matches.rationale: Finding 1 correctly identifies the corrupted Rodrigues' formula in Equation 3, noting the incorrect sign on the cosine term (1 + cosθ instead of 1 − cosθ) and explaining why this produces an invalid rotation matrix. This directly detects the ground truth defect.

Finding 2 identifies the undefined βt term in Equation 1's forward noising process (zt = αt z0 + βt δt ε), noting it is never defined and creates inconsistency with the variance-preserving constraint. This directly detects the ground truth defect about undefined notation.
No finding addresses the dimensional inconsistency in zmotion (R^{k×5×h×w} vs R^{k×3×h×w}) or the resulting channel concatenation mismatch described in ground truth 3.
